description: 16-engine AI visibility report: five category questions, each asked 3 times (240 answers), to ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Grok, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Perplexity, Meta AI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, GLM, MiniMax, Exa Answer and You.com. Returns per-engine answers, mention rate, citations of the site (own domain in the returned sources), a visibility score, competitor share of mentions (overall and per engine), the sources engines cited, and a report_url. Takes 2-4 minutes. Not charged unless at least 12 of 16 engines answer. Costs $9 USDC per call via x402 (payment in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or a failed run returns an error and is not charged.
